notes.title: Beta Version 2
notes.content:
[list]
[*]  New milestones and achievements are introduced to enrich your gaming experience.
[*]   Adjustments have been made to the rendering of Earth's clouds
[*]  Access to the Steam Overlay is now available within the game
[*]  Correction to the Minimap display were made to ajust the size.
[/list]

[b]Caution:[/b]
Due to essential updates in this version, all existing save files will need to be reset. This reset is critical to address a potential critical issue that could affect future gameplay stability. We understand the inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding as we strive to ensure the best gaming experience.
